title: Water Heaters — Tank, Tankless, Service & Replace
headline:
A clean install.
Done the way it should be.
shortDescription: Gas and electric tank water heaters, tankless conversions, anode-rod service, full flushes, expansion tanks, and code-correct venting — installed by the same plumber who'll service it later.
lead: If your water heater is ten or more years old, the question isn't whether it'll fail — it's whether you'd rather replace it on a Tuesday or wake up to a flooded utility room. I install a few water heaters every week across NW Portland and the Westside: standard 40 and 50-gallon tanks, condensing tankless units, and the occasional electric heat-pump retrofit. Pricing is flat per scope of work — no hidden permit fees, no surprise venting upcharges, no "that valve isn't included."

sections.heading: What's covered
sections.intro: Common scopes priced flat. Anything outside the standard install gets a written estimate before we start.

items.label: 50-gal gas tank — $1,650 installed
items.body: Standard atmospheric vent, includes new T&P valve, drip pan, expansion tank if required, and haul-off of the old unit

items.label: 50-gal electric tank — $1,890 installed
items.body: Includes new shutoffs, expansion tank, and haul-off. Most NW Portland panels handle this without an upgrade

items.label: Tankless gas conversion — $4,800–$6,400
items.body: Condensing tankless unit, gas line resize if needed, PVC venting, condensate drain, and isolation valves. Free written estimate

items.label: Heat-pump water heater — $3,400–$4,200
items.body: Electric heat-pump retrofit for a garage or basement install. Big efficiency gains; PGE rebates often apply

items.label: Inspect-and-flush service — $329 flat
items.body: Annual maintenance: full flush, anode check, T&P test, expansion-tank pressure check, written report. Adds years to a tank

items.label: Same-day failure replacement
items.body: If your heater fails before noon and I've got a unit in the truck, you're in hot water by dinner. Same-day fee is $150 over standard install

sections.heading: How a replacement goes
sections.body: A standard 50-gallon swap is usually a 3 to 4 hour job from arrival to hot water on the tap.
items: Drain and disconnect the old unit — water, gas or electrical, venting
Set the new heater on a fresh drip pan, square to the wall, with new shutoffs and supply lines
Install or replace the expansion tank if the home has a backflow preventer (most do)
Re-vent and re-gas (or rewire), pressure-test, and pull a permit through the city or county where required
Flush, fill, and verify the burner cycles through to a clean shutoff. Photos and the written invoice before I leave. 1-year workmanship warranty plus full manufacturer warranty pass-through
